::: {#sol-train-mlp}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(mlp.parameters(), lr=0.5)
for step in range(500):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss = loss_fn(mlp(x_train), y_train)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()

with torch.no_grad():
    predicted = mlp(x_test).argmax(dim=1)
test_accuracy = (predicted == y_test).float().mean().item()
print(loss.item(), test_accuracy)
```

The trained network classifies `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * py$test_accuracy)`% of the `r py$n_test` test images correctly,
against 10% for guessing.
The loop is the [training step](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-training-step) of the PyTorch chapter,
and the predicted digit is the one with the largest [logit](#def-logits),
which is also the one with the largest softmax probability.

:::
